fields.description: Issue features an editorial urging the grand jury to question Circuit Judge Stanley Milledge regarding claims of large-scale graft and criticizes Miami’s daily newspapers for attempting to influence or control grand jury proceedings. Includes extensive discussion of suspended detective C. O. Huttoe and prior grand jury findings, commentary on press practices and an advertising-censorship dispute involving City Commissioner H. Leslie Quigg and attorney Abe Aronovitz, and coverage of gambling raids allegedly tipped off by news publicity. Additional local columns address hotel license statistics, liquor-related municipal court offenses, a railroad crossing fatality, entertainment/nightlife notes, and summaries of divorce filings.
coverage: Greater Miami (Dade County), Florida, United States
